headline.title: We searched "physiotherapy Westboro Ottawa". A competitor appeared seven times. Anatomy Physiotherapy appeared zero times.
headline.detail: Ottawa Physiotherapy & Sport Clinics took Medimap, Poyst, Sports Clinic Finder and more; Physiocare appeared twice. Patients searching for exactly what you do met them, not the clinic with 333 five-star reviews.

summary: Anatomy Physiotherapy Westboro has 333 five-star reviews and patients who say your physios explain every step. But in our search for physiotherapy in Westboro you didn't appear once, while a clinic a few blocks away appeared seven times and another with 513 reviews is open seven days.

search.result: Ottawa Physiotherapy & Sport Clinics – Westboro appeared seven times (Medimap, Poyst, Sports Clinic Finder and others); Physiocare appeared twice. Anatomy Physiotherapy did not appear.

scenario: A woman in Westboro wakes up with the room spinning. She searches "vertigo physiotherapy Westboro", finds a directory listing for the clinic down the street, and books there, never knowing the clinic around the corner has a vestibular specialist with glowing reviews. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your patients keep raving about you, but new ones keep finding your neighbours first. The clinics that appear everywhere keep growing.
